Benfica season|2021–22]] | nextseason = [[2023–24 S.L. Benfica season|2023–24]] }} The 2022–23 [[S.L. Benfica|Sport Lisboa e Benfica]] season was the club's [[List of S.L. Benfica seasons|119th season]] in existence and its 89th consecutive season in the top flight of [[Football in Portugal|Portuguese football]]. It started on 2 August 2022, with the [[2022–23 UEFA Champions League qualifying phase and play-off round#Third qualifying round|third qualifying round]] of the [[2022–23 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]], where Benfica qualified for the [[2022–23 UEFA Champions League group stage|group stage]], reaching the quarter-finals, and concluded on 27 May 2023. Domestically, Benfica played in the [[2022–23 Primeira Liga|Primeira Liga]], [[2022–23 Taça de Portugal|Taça de Portugal]], and [[2022–23 Taça da Liga|Taça da Liga]], winning the league title for a record-extending 38th time in their history.
